text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now, Tamtam, what are you doing here? Is
there something you
needed in the
right-side room?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, y'know, I was just worried how you
three were gettin' on.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...That's all? Are you suuure you weren't
sneaking over to facilitate a
conversation
between Rice and Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I mean yeah, but how'd ya...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I knew it. You're such a sweetheart,
Tamtam. Whenever
someone needs help,
you leap right into action. But...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya wouldn't make a preschooler tally up
the family's monthly budget,
would ya?
Just let Bourbon focus on her strengths.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't sweat it! I'll fix it up later, so
leave it there for me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Have you tried waiting for them?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Waiting?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
For them to figure things out themselves.
I'm not telling you to stop
helping, but
you shouldn't do everything for them.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Just give them a little hint... and then wait.
They might not get it on
the first try, but
that's part of learning.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You have to believe in them—that's what
caretaking is all about.

text_block_list.name: Rob Roy & Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Tamamo. Can I come after all?

Creek, we solved the mystery. Can you
please gather everyone?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Because they can do it if they try.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whew, we managed to make it out.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, Rice? Did you and Bourbon... g-get a
chance to talk? While you
were in... the
other room...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I guess we spoke a little. Kind of. We
honestly just, um...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rattle.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Aaah!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Your reactions are very pronounced. This
is good reference material
for tricks that
will scare guests.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh... I-is it really?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Bourbon worked out the riddle
herself. I was too scared to
do much.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But that's okay. All I ever do is get in the
way, so I'm really happy she
called me a
good reference.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And that's all thanks to you inviting us to
visit the park with you.
Hehe... Thank you.
I really appreciate everything you've done,
Rob
Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's a relief... I'm just glad I could be of
help!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Rob Roy?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... I was so worried that I'd
dragged you both here and
marched you
around the park without considering your
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I, I had no idea. If anything, you seemed
extra confident today.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You can thank Sweep for that. She lent me
a wand.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It lets me speak my mind like Sweep does.
Almost like... the magic
has transformed
me into a real witch.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Transformed you?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Halloween is a day to dress up and dare to
be someone else. You can
borrow the
costume's power to say things you can't
say yourself.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... deep down, you were
nervous too? And all this
time, you've
been hiding it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I was, but you seemed so down. I
had to do something, even
if it was
forward of me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Rice, Rob Roy. We're heading to the next
area.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
We'll be right there! And, Rice, um... I also
wanted to say...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You keep saying you're in the way, but to
me, your presence is always
warm and
supporting. I've been really wanting... to
tell you that.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy...
